email.body1:
Scott, saw AKUVO signed 11 new customers in Q1 and just launched AKUVO IQ on the back of the TransUnion partnership.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AKUVO off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for AKUVO.

With new logos landing every quarter, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AKUVO needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for AKUVO.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AKUVO's reply rate likely compares to other growing fintech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
